summary: This Form 6-K reports that Brera Holdings PLC (d/b/a Solmate Infrastructure) regained compliance with Nasdaq's minimum bid price requirement (Listing Rule 5550(a)(2)) after effecting a 1-for-10 reverse share split on May 14, 2026. Nasdaq confirmed compliance and cancelled a scheduled June 2, 2026 hearing. No special-situation event occurs; this is a routine compliance update. The filing acts as a foreign private issuer's current report on Form 6-K, analogous to a U.S. Form 8-K for a listing standard compliance notice. What to watch: continued adherence to Nasdaq listing standards.
